description: This file defines a singleton object 'NotesSyncScheduler' that provides methods to schedule periodic and one-off synchronization tasks using Android's WorkManager. It sets network constraints and enqueues jobs for syncing notes, encapsulating schedule management and avoiding direct calls to WorkManager from UI components.

classes.name: NotesSyncScheduler
classes.description: A singleton object that manages scheduling of periodic and one-off synchronization tasks for notes, using network constraints.

methods.name: schedulePeriodic
methods.description: Schedules a periodic sync task to run every 6 hours with network connectivity constraint. Intended to be called once during application startup.

methods.name: enqueueOneOff
methods.description: Enqueues a one-time sync task with network connectivity constraint, for manual sync actions triggered by the user.
